motionFidelity.unchanged: 30 fps; 1920×1080; circle R=130; card 520×300, corner R=20; cubic path topology; 10–30 breath at 1→1.12→1; 30–54 morph; 56–68 content fade; easing curves; grayscale colors.
motionFidelity.timingImpactOfCopy: None; there is no source text or Persian replacement.

visualVerification.findings: Opening circle matches the source frame. The breath is centered, the mid-morph has the expected smooth barrel contour, content fades inside the settled outline, all placeholder bars align to the right, and the final frame is stable and unclipped.

concerns: The upstream reference MP4 is truncated to the 20-frame registry duration. It supplies opening-frame visual comparison but no source frames for the morph or final card. Later fidelity was checked against the untouched source component and source prompt, alongside Persian frames rendered with --duration 140.

lessons.symptom: A text-free UI placeholder card can appear to need no localization even though its short bars and avatar retain left-to-right reading order.
lessons.cause: The bars are abstract shapes, but their alignment and sequence still stand in for text and UI content.
lessons.fix: Apply RTL to the content layer so bars share the right start edge and the avatar begins the footer row on the right; preserve symmetric outline geometry and motion.
